fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-07-20, around 19:20, a caller allegedly threatened the complainant with harm over a financial disagreement, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-07-21. Saranya Murugan reported the matter orally at Ernakulam Central PS; the contact number given was 9000000193. The complaint mentions Vignesh Thangaraj, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000009, in connection with the events. Items referenced in the complaint: mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly made threats over a personal dispute.
fields.Keywords: threat, phone calls, shopping complex, evening, suspect, phone records, mobile number
